controls_reviewed: Exact raw GitHub host/commit/twelve paths; redirects/proxies/authentication excluded
1MiB per body/4MiB aggregate retained-body reservation; unknown receipts stop remaining requests
20s full-child cap, 300s aggregate checkpoints and 30s finalization reserve; capture caps64KiB each
Exclusive source-output reservation; lstat/reparse and resolved-containment checks
One fixed isolated child argv at a time; minimal environment, EOF stdin pipe, owned PID kill/reap
Fsynced progress, attempts and hash-chained journal; no automatic retry/restart/substitution
Terminal receipt and post-lease deadlines; authoritative failure marker vetoes prior qualification
scope_limits: Read-only helper/protocol/fixture inspection and stdlib rehash; no helper import/execution or fetch.

Fetched source remains data only; no compilation, DLL/GGUF access, tokenizer, context, inference or server authorized.
